decisions.decision: Request lifecycle modeled as two NEW booking_status enum values: requested + approved (keep pending exclusively for the 15-min instant hold)
decisions.rationale: Unambiguous per-status TTL; reduces the webhook confirm change to a one-line WHERE widening (status IN ('pending','approved')); reuses already-present declined/completed. Resolved a CONTEXT.md 'Claude's Discretion' item in RESEARCH.md.

decisions.decision: 3-file migration sequence: 0010 enum ADD VALUE (own file) -> 0011 columns + listing default flip -> 0012 DROP+ADD booking_no_overlap EXCLUDE with widened WHERE
decisions.rationale: Postgres forbids using a newly-ADDed enum value in the same transaction, and you cannot ALTER an EXCLUDE constraint's WHERE in place. Sequencing sidesteps both.

decisions.decision: Decline surfaces behind a confirm dialog; Approve inline; both neutral (not destructive-red)
decisions.rationale: A decline is an expected outcome not an error; matches the Phase-5 neutral-badge precedent. Locked the D-65 'Claude's Discretion' UI item in UI-SPEC.
